image_description: A minimalist interior staircase featuring a white cylindrical newel post topped with a sculptural, looped finial. A sleek, metallic tubular handrail extends diagonally from the newel post up the green-painted wall. The stairs are light-colored wood or laminate. The scene is lit by artificial light, casting soft shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrail clearly follows the diagonal incline of the stairs against the wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous handrail supported by evenly spaced balusters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a 'floating' or wall-mounted handrail design. There are no visible balusters supporting the rail along its length; it appears anchored only at the newel post and potentially into the wall (though wall anchors are not clearly visible). Therefore, the specific feature of 'evenly spaced balusters' is absent in this specific design variant.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No balusters are present in the visible section of the railing.

artifact_observations.location: Connection between handrail and newel post/wall
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point where the metal rail meets the white newel post is visually ambiguous. There is no clear bracket, weld, or insertion point visible. The rail seems to float slightly above or merge indistinctly with the post cap. Additionally, the upper support on the wall is barely visible as a small faint mark, raising questions about structural plausibility, though this may be a perspective issue rather than a generation artifact.

The wall texture is extremely smooth and uniform, lacking the subtle micro-variations of painted drywall. It has a slight 'airbrushed' look common in AI generations, but not severe enough to break realism entirely.

The sculptural loop on top of the newel post has a slightly melted or ill-defined geometry. The edges are soft, and the internal hole of the loop doesn't have sharp definition, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

Geometric correctness of the newel post finial (loop shape)

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection point between the metal rail and the white newel post. In real-world construction, this requires a visible bracket or welding. If the AI has blended them seamlessly without mechanical logic, flag it as a structural artifact. Also, evaluate if the 'floating' nature of the rail is a valid modern design or a generation error omitting necessary supports.
